definitions.explanation: With exactness and no room for error, especially regarding time, amounts, or measurements.
Fitting closely with no gaps or looseness.

examples.japanese: きっちり⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
⟦{代金|だいきん}→代金：03416_daikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧きっちり⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧きっちり{五時|ごじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{退社|たいしゃ}→退社：06156_taisha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He always leaves the office at exactly five o'clock.

examples.japanese: ふた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きっちり⟦{閉|し}まっている→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧。
⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧きっちり⟦{畳|たた}んだ→畳む：02073_tatamu⟧。
⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きっちり⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: The books are lined up neatly on the shelf.

notes:
きっちり emphasizes precision and leaving no room for error or gaps. It conveys thoroughness and meticulousness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- きっちり⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: keep time precisely
- きっちり⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: pay the exact amount
- きっちり⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧: shut tightly
- きっちり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a meticulous person (na-adjective use)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦きちんと→きちんと：00222_kichinto⟧: properly, neatly (broader — about doing things the right way)
- ⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧: exactly, perfectly fitting (often for size or match)
- ⟦きっかり→きっかり：21132_kikkari⟧: exactly, precisely (numbers and time only)
- ⟦ちゃんと→ちゃんと：02359_chanto⟧: properly (more casual, often used with children)

REGISTER:
Neutral. Used in both spoken and written Japanese.
